subject.title: chat-realtime.test.ts is environment-dependent: green on hosted CI, 1 failure on Testbox, 4 failures on macOS local

question: Should maintainers keep this protected issue as manual test-infra work, or remove the protected label so a narrow deterministic test fix can be queued later?
rationale: The issue is concrete and likely small, but the protected `maintainer` label means automation should not close or route a repair without maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep manual owner
options.body: A maintainer owns the cross-environment repro and fix decision before any automated repair lane is used.

options.title: Allow repair queue later
options.body: Remove the protected label after confirming the desired fix boundary so ClawSweeper can queue a focused test-determinism PR.

options.title: Close after external proof
options.body: Close only if maintainers independently confirm current main no longer reproduces on the reported Testbox and macOS paths.

recommendation.title: Keep manual owner
recommendation.body: A maintainer owns the cross-environment repro and fix decision before any automated repair lane is used.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history signal for the chat realtime test surface and reported the current cross-environment failure.
